caption.text:
Sebuah momen haru terjadi saat seorang anggota polisi Polres Lamongan menggelar kegiatan berbagi tas sekolah dan paket makan Jumat Berkah di SD Desa Sidobinangun, Kecamatan Deket, Lamongan. Di tengah kegiatan itu, ia tak menyangka bisa bertemu kembali dengan teman sekolah sekaligus teman sebangkunya yang sedang bekerja sebagai kuli bangunan di lokasi tersebut.

Pertemuan berlangsung penuh haru. Pelukan berubah menjadi emosional ketika rekan sebangkunya dulu tak kuasa menahan air mata sambil menceritakan perjalanan hidupnya selama beberapa tahun terakhir.

Diketahui, lelaki itu sebelumnya pernah mencoba berjualan dengan bantuan modal dari polisi tersebut. Sayangnya usaha tidak berjalan sesuai harapan, sehingga kini ia bekerja sebagai buruh bangunan demi menghidupi keluarga. Dalam obrolan mereka, pria itu juga mengaku belum memiliki sepeda motor untuk berangkat bekerja maupun mengantar anaknya ke sekolah setiap hari.

Mendengar cerita itu, sang polisi langsung berniat membantu lagi. Ia berjanji akan membelikan sepeda motor untuk sahabat lamanya agar aktivitas bekerja dan kebutuhan keluarga bisa lebih mudah dijalani. Respect!

Video: Instagram/purnomopolisibaik

[Baca berita dan informasi menarik lainnya hanya di www.indozone.id]
caption.text_translation:
A touching moment happened when a policeman of Lamongan Police Station called the activity of sharing school bags and meal packs of Blessed Friday at Sidobinangun Village Elementary School, Kecamatan District, Lamongan. In the midst of the activity, he didn't expect to be reunited with his schoolmates and classmates who were working as a construction worker in the site.

The meeting is going on in full swing. The hug turned emotional when her former co-worker couldn't hold back tears as she recounted her life journey over the past few years.

It is known that the man had previously tried to sell with the help of capital from the police. Unfortunately the efforts did not go as expected, until now he works as a construction worker for the sake of supporting the family. In their conversation, the man also admitted that he has neither had a motorcycle to go to work nor to take his child to school every day.

Hearing the story, the police immediately intended to help again. He promised to buy a motorcycle for his old friend so that his work and family needs could be lived easier. Respect!

Video: Instagram/purnomopolisisgood
